      Abstract

      Unless NP⊆BPPNP\subseteq BPPNP⊆BPP, for every constant ε>0\varepsilon>0ε>0, Max Independent Set on NNN-vertex triangle-free graphs admits no polynomial-time N1/2−εN^{1/2-\varepsilon}N1/2−ε-approximation algorithm. This is the main inapproximability theorem of Tight Inapproximability of Max Independent Set in Triangle-Free Graphs.
